_note: Sentence pairs for validating the semantic corroboration matcher's cosine-similarity threshold. Sentence A in each pair is verbatim from gold_eval_set.json (real ingested article text); sentence B is a hand-written paraphrase or a genuinely distinct claim about the same topic. This is a threshold-calibration set, not a claim-level fact-check gold set -- once real ingestion has run and produced duplicate/near-duplicate coverage of the same event across multiple outlets, re-derive this fixture from that real duplication instead of paraphrases (see evaluate_corroboration.py docstring).
